reviews.comment: Lots of reading and writing (as expected).  Ryan is super understanding and lots of fun, though!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--So many papers

reviews.comment: Very easy class as long as you do the work. Discussion posts twice a week, but are not time-consuming at all. You don't hear much from the prof, but he was very good at updating us during corona time. He is not a tough grader, and an A is easily achievable as long as you submit the work. Highly recommend

This class was pretty easy but was honestly a mess. Takes attendance every class but all you do in class is sit there. Random quizzes about once a week but they aren't hard. A lot of outside reading and movie watching but you can usually get away without doing it. He's a nice guy but the class organization was just kind of all over the place.

Professor Neighbors was really chill. Made class really easy. He takes attendance every class and has quizzes over readings/movies, but they're easy if you knew anything about what you read. Three papers, a group project, and no exams. Have to write journal pages to turn in but they're either discussions on eCampus or easy writing practices.

His classes are just group discussion over the material you were suppose to read/watch before class. Lots of outside work, you seriously just talk in class but attendance is mandatory so you have to go. The major essays are the only real assignments and he grades them pretty hard. Make sure to go to his office hours and use the UWC if you want an A
